rule.name: compositor
rule.note: File: named overrides for processes whose default classification is wrong. The rule engine classifies ALL processes by default (uid>0 in user session -> interactive; uid>0 user service -> system; uid=0 / system service -> system) — this file only needs entries that need DIFFERENT treatment from that default, or oom_score_adj protection. Compositors/WMs would default to interactive (correct tier) but must NOT be moved (cgroup managed by logind), so only oom is set here.

rule.name: display-manager
rule.note: Display managers default to system tier (fine); just needs OOM protection.

rule.name: dbus
rule.note: D-Bus must stay in its own scope (no cgroup move); protect from OOM.
